item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya wants to see a candle flame through three holes punched in three cardboard sheets in her classroom.
In which arrangement will she be able to see the flame?

options.A: the three holes are in a straight line and Priya's eye is in line with the holes
options.B: the three holes are in a straight line but Priya's eye is above the line of the holes
options.C: the middle hole is slightly higher than the other two holes
options.D: the candle is made brighter so its light can pass through any arrangement of the holes
